params.markdown:
This dashboard provides visibility into managed devices from the `iru.device` data stream. Metrics summarize total devices, MDM enrollment, agent installation, and missing devices. Charts break down the fleet by platform, model, blueprint, and assigned user. Tables list the full device inventory and non-reporting devices. Use the Platform, Blueprint, and Missing controls to filter the view.
